_about: Verification notes found by recomputing every worked example (tests/unit/syllabus-answers.mjs). The syllabus text is never edited by the app; these notes are shown beside the example so learners see both values. Fix the syllabus in its next version, then remove the entry.

errata.note: Recomputing the 4-year, 5% annual-coupon bond at a 6% yield gives 96.5349, which rounds to 96.53 (the syllabus shows 96.54). The interpolated yield (≈ 6.46%) and the exact yield (6.458%) are unaffected.
